prompt: You are relaxing on a sunny beach vacation when something completely bizarre begins to happen all around you. Call your friend and describe everything you see.
sample:
Hey Maria, you are not going to believe what is happening right now. I'm standing on the beach, and the most bizarre thing just started. I had to call and tell you about it because it makes no sense at all.

First, even though it's a warm, sunny day with blue skies, it has started snowing. I'm not joking, white snowflakes are falling everywhere. The beautiful sand is now covered in a thick layer of white snow. Also, everyone is still wearing their swimsuits, so they look very confused and cold. There's a woman in a turquoise bikini right in front of me with her mouth wide open in shock. A man in red shorts next to her is shivering. It feels so strange because the air is warm but snow is landing on my skin. In the distance, some people are still sitting under an umbrella as if nothing is wrong. This is the most unusual thing I have ever seen. Do you think I'm dreaming?
